about: The priest holds his hands over the gifts and quietly prays this portion of the Canon for those whom God has regenerated from water and the Holy Spirit. The same form is prescribed in both the Easter and Pentecost periods: from the Easter Vigil or Pentecost Vigil through the Saturday of the corresponding octave.

seg.nr: Holding his outstretched hands over the gifts, the priest says:

seg.tr: Therefore, Lord, we ask that You graciously accept this offering of our service and also of Your entire family, which we offer to You also on behalf of those whom You graciously regenerated from water and the Holy Spirit, granting them remission of all sins,
and order our days in Your peace, and command that we be rescued from eternal condemnation and counted in the flock of Your chosen.

a.g: and order our days in Your peace

ex.w052: We ask God to command both our rescue from eternal condemnation and our inclusion in the flock of His chosen. Both outcomes depend on the same command, despite their separation in the Latin order.
